falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5650 on any daily close within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 77% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom was followed by a sustained rally, not an immediate reversal to new highs; this would indicate the pattern has broken toward bullish continuation rather than the expected bottoming behavior

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 40 suggests elevated but not extreme complacency; sustained VIX sub-14 would indicate risk appetite has normalized completely, invalidating the 'bottom' signal which requires persistent fear/volatility to mark a tradable low

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with yields near local highs (~4.20%); a sharp rally in bonds (yields sub-3.80%) would signal flight-to-safety or recession pricing that contradicts the cyclical bottom thesis, indicating macro deterioration rather than a corrective low

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
